predictions.prediction_text: Market maker exposure will lead to shorter upside volatility.
predictions.expected_result: Observed option-implied volatility on the upside will compress into shorter-dated maturities or show reduced upside vega sensitivity over subsequent sessions.

predictions.prediction_text: If market makers need to hedge to the upside they will buy long volatility trades, causing volatility to rise.
predictions.condition: market makers need to hedge to the upside
predictions.expected_result: Option-implied volatility (especially for upside/OTM calls) will increase following such hedging activity.

predictions.prediction_text: Market makers will shorten upside gamma and vega exposure.
predictions.expected_result: Market makers' net gamma and vega for upside strikes will decrease, reflected in reduced dealer-provided liquidity and altered option skew dynamics.
